key_impacts: In Dakshin Bedkashi Union, 33 people were killed
In Dakshin Bedkashi Union, 3,520 houses were washed away and 1,800 were partially damaged
Storm surge overtopped and breached the coastal embankment in Dakshin Bedkashi at six places, damaging 20.55 km of embankment

events.event_hazard: Prolonged twice-daily tidal inundation due to breached coastal polders
key_impacts: Villages were inundated twice a day by tidal water until rehabilitation in 2013
Recovery of housing and other sectors was delayed
